description: EXISTS block filter — 'documents where there EXISTS a related TASK assigned to me'. Demonstrates the 3 required control keys ($$EXISTSMOD, $$OBJCODE, $$ID with FIELD: prefix). Mirrors client-b-sample/DOCU-pending-approval-uift.json.
notes: EXISTS:<letter>: prefix — letters identify the block (a/b/c for multiple EXISTS blocks)
$$OBJCODE: the related-object type — TASK here means 'I have a related task ID via taskID'
$$ID: 'FIELD:taskID' joins the EXISTS block's ID to the outer record's taskID field. FIELD: prefix is literal.
EXISTS:a:assignedToID & _Mod: the actual constraint on the related TASK
Combine with bare keys to AND-join: '... AND task assigned to me'
Multiple EXISTS blocks use a/b/c/... — they AND-combine
